info.name: Events FST — microservices Spring Cloud
info.description: Toutes les requêtes passent par l'API Gateway ({{gateway}}). Générée par postman/generate.py.

item.name: participant-service
item.description:
**participant-service** — repris de `feature/participant (Farah Baraket)`.

### Ancien endpoint → nouvel endpoint via la Gateway

| Monolithe (/events, port 8089) | Microservices (via la Gateway, port 8088) |
|---|---|
| `POST /events/participant/add` | `POST /api/participants` |
| `GET /events/participant/all` | `GET /api/participants` |
| `GET /events/participant/{id}` | `GET /api/participants/{id}` |
| `PUT /events/participant/update/{id}` | `PUT /api/participants/{id}` |
| `PUT /events/participant/{id}/tache/{tache}` | `PUT /api/participants/{id}/tache/{tache}` |
| `DELETE /events/participant/delete/{id}` | `DELETE /api/participants/{id}` |
| `POST /events/event/addPart` | `POST /api/participants` |
| `(nouveau, pour Feign)` | `GET /api/participants?ids=1,2` |
| `(nouveau, pour calculCout)` | `GET /api/participants/search?nom=&prenom=&tache=` |

item.name: event-service
item.description:
**event-service** — repris de `feature/event (Nour Mustapha), corrections de feature/feedback`.

### Ancien endpoint → nouvel endpoint via la Gateway

| Monolithe (/events, port 8089) | Microservices (via la Gateway, port 8088) |
|---|---|
| `POST /events/event/addEvent` | `POST /api/events (participantIds vérifiés par Feign)` |
| `POST /events/event/addEvent/{id}` | `POST /api/events/participant/{idPart}` |
| `PUT /events/event/addAffectLog/{description}` | `PUT /api/events/by-description/{description}/logistics` |
| `GET /events/event/getLogs/{d1}/{d2}` | `GET /api/events/logistics/{d1}/{d2}` |
| `POST /events/event/addPart` | `POST /api/participants (participant-service)` |
| `(aucune lecture)` | `GET /api/events, GET /api/events/{id}` |
| `(nouveau, composition Feign)` | `GET /api/events/{id}/details` |
| `(nouveau)` | `PUT /api/events/{id}, DELETE /api/events/{id}` |
| `(nouveau)` | `POST /api/events/{id}/participants/{idPart}` |
| `(nouveau)` | `POST /api/events/{id}/logistics` |
| `calculCout @Scheduled 60 s` | `idem + POST /api/events/cout/recalcul` |

item.name: Créer un événement pour un participant

exec:
const ev = pm.response.json().find(e => e.idEvent === pm.collectionVariables.get('eventId'));
pm.test('Coût = 250 (réservé seulement)', () => pm.expect(ev.cout).to.eql(250));

statistics-service (mon module) — CQRS, côté requêtes
item.description:
**statistics-service (mon module) — CQRS, côté requêtes** — repris de `feature/event-statistics (Roudayna Kouka) + note moyenne de feature/feedback`.

### Ancien endpoint → nouvel endpoint via la Gateway

| Monolithe (/events, port 8089) | Microservices (via la Gateway, port 8088) |
|---|---|
| `GET /events/event-stats` | `GET /api/stats/events` |
| `GET /events/event-stats/{id}` | `GET /api/stats/events/{id} (UUID)` |
| `GET /events/event-stats/summary` | `GET /api/stats/summary` |
| `GET /events/event-stats/upcoming` | `GET /api/stats/upcoming` |
| `GET /events/event-stats/between/{d1}/{d2}` | `GET /api/stats/between/{d1}/{d2}` |
| `(nouveau)` | `en-tête X-Stats-Source : projections-cqrs (phase 3) ; feign-avant-cqrs si stats.source=feign` |
| `(nouveau, CQRS)` | `GET /api/stats/admin/projection, POST /api/stats/admin/replay` |
